data.situation:
On Thursday, 27 May, Maya set three date cards on the meeting table. Jo outlined a proposed policy for later opening on one evening a week. The first initiative would be a trial reading session. As residents arrived, a problem began to emerge: the proposed evening clashed with an existing hall booking. Ellen thought changing every booking would be impractical. Jo unfolded a bus timetable beside her draft. Her prediction of thirty visitors depended on the bus still running after the session, and a resident said limited transport could hinder attendance. There was also controversy over using the courtyard after dark; nearby residents wanted quieter evenings. Maya moved one date card aside. The group began looking at a shorter indoor session, and Ellen opened a fresh page for the questions they still needed answered. MEETING NOTES — 27 MAY, 6 P.M.
The group will ask the local authorities about possible support for the trial session. No response has been received. Ellen steers clear of personal accusations and records the objections to evening courtyard use. The next draft will show the existing bookings, bus times and a shorter indoor option. Jo will bring it to the next meeting.

readingBlocks.en: On Thursday, 27 May, Maya set three date cards on the meeting table. Jo outlined a proposed policy for later opening on one evening a week. The first initiative would be a trial reading session. As residents arrived, a problem began to emerge: the proposed evening clashed with an existing hall booking. Ellen thought changing every booking would be impractical. Jo unfolded a bus timetable beside her draft. Her prediction of thirty visitors depended on the bus still running after the session, and a resident said limited transport could hinder attendance. readingBlocks.zh: 5月27日星期四，玛雅在会议桌上摆好三张日期卡。乔介绍了一项拟议方针：每周有一个晚上延长开放时间。第一个新项目是试办一场阅读活动。居民到来后，一个问题开始显现：拟定的晚上与现有大厅预订冲突。埃伦觉得更改所有预订不切实际。乔在草稿旁摊开公交时刻表。她预测会有三十人到场，但这取决于活动结束后公交是否仍运行；一位居民说交通有限可能妨碍大家参加。天黑后使用院子也引发了争议，附近居民希望夜晚更安静。玛雅把一张日期卡挪到一边。大家开始考虑一场更短的室内活动，埃伦另翻一页，记录仍需回答的问题。

readingBlocks.en:
MEETING NOTES — 27 MAY, 6 P.M.
The group will ask the local authorities about possible support for the trial session. No response has been received. Ellen steers clear of personal accusations and records the objections to evening courtyard use. The next draft will show the existing bookings, bus times and a shorter indoor option. Jo will bring it to the next meeting.
readingBlocks.zh:
会议纪要——5月27日18:00
小组将向地方管理机构询问试办活动可能获得的支持。目前尚未收到回复。埃伦避免指责个人，并记录了对夜间使用院子的反对意见。下一版草稿会列明已有预订、公交时间和一项较短的室内活动方案。乔会把它带到下次会议。

glossary.zh: 负责管理或决策的官方机构
glossary.note: 此义可数且常用复数 authorities；the local authorities 指地方管理机构，不是抽象权力。
glossary.example: The group will ask the local authorities about possible support.
glossary.exampleZh: 小组将向地方管理机构询问可能获得的支持。

glossary.note: 本句 a proposed policy 是尚在讨论的总体安排，不是已经实施的规定或保险保单。
glossary.example: Jo outlined a proposed policy for later opening.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔介绍了延长开放时间的拟议方针。

externalEvidence.definition: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group

glossary.note: an initiative 指为改善安排新提出的项目；本课不是个人主动性或主动权。
glossary.example: The first initiative would be a trial reading session.
glossary.exampleZh: 第一个新项目是试办一场阅读活动。

glossary.note: 可数名词 prediction；三十人是取决于公交条件的预估，并非已知结果。
glossary.example: Jo’s prediction of thirty visitors depended on the bus still running.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔预测会有三十名访客到场，但这取决于公交是否仍运行。

externalEvidence.definition: a statement made about the future

glossary.note: 不及物动词 emerge；a problem began to emerge 表示问题逐渐被注意到。
glossary.example: A problem began to emerge as residents arrived.
glossary.exampleZh: 居民到来后，一个问题开始显现。

glossary.note: 本句 controversy over + doing 说明参与者对夜间使用院子有实际分歧。
glossary.example: There was controversy over using the courtyard after dark.
glossary.exampleZh: 天黑后使用院子引发了争议。

externalEvidence.definition: a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement

glossary.zh: 不切实际的；难以实施的
glossary.note: changing every booking would be impractical：在现有安排下难以实施，不单指不喜欢。
glossary.example: Ellen thought changing every booking would be impractical.
glossary.exampleZh: 埃伦觉得更改所有预订不切实际。

externalEvidence.definition: not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters

glossary.note: hinder attendance 指让参加更困难，不一定完全阻止。
glossary.exampleZh: 交通有限可能妨碍大家参加。

externalEvidence.definition: be a hindrance or obstacle to

glossary.note: steer clear of + 名词；本句避免会议中的人身指责，steers 是第三人称变化。
glossary.example: Ellen steers clear of personal accusations.
